messages:
samir: Heads-up — planning an evening DB cutover tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Need owners for schema migration, backfill window, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. Who can take what?
elaine: I can own the migration + smoke. I'll be available from 01:30 UTC and will run the smoke script and watch logs. :thumbsup:
rob: I'll take the backfill job and replica-lag monitoring. Plan to start backfill at ~02:10 UTC if migration and smoke pass.
chen: I'll prepare the rollback runbook and be on-call for rollback exec. Rollback triggers I'm tracking: replica_lag > 2m OR >0.5% failed txs in the first 10m.
elaine: Smoke commands I'll run:
```
# smoke test - run against canary DB instance
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/smoke -d '{"user_id":"smoke-1"}'
# check basic read/write path
pg_isready -q && psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM migrations_smoke;"
```
rob: Will publish expected lag metrics and a quick grafana panel link before cutover. I'll also script an automatic pause if lag exceeds threshold.
natalie: Support update — @jordan is on-call but traveling. Jordan, are you good with this timing?
jordan: I can be reachable by phone and Slack for the window, yes. Ping me 30m before cutover.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance slot reserved 02:00-03:00 UTC. SLA ticket M-789 created and attached to this thread.
samir: Can we do a staging dry-run tonight at 22:00 UTC? Elaine + Rob confirm staging dry-run so rollback timings are validated.
elaine: Confirmed for staging run at 22:00. I'll run the exact smoke steps.
rob: Confirmed — I'll trigger the backfill on staging and capture lag curves.
chen: I'll simulate rollback on staging to validate RTO and runbook steps.
samir: Final checklist (please reply with ✅):
- Migration owner (samir) — ✅
- Smoke owner (elaine) — ✅
- Backfill owner (rob) — ✅
- Rollback owner (chen) — ✅
- Support / pager (jordan) — ✅
- Calendar + #migration-alerts notice (samir) — ✅
- Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-cutover — please read before 01:00 UTC.
elaine: I'll paste smoke output to this thread during the run and escalate if anything odd (:eyes:).
rob: I'll post the backfill start/stop times and lag numbers. If anything >2m lag I'll pause and call it out.
chen: Rollback TL;DR: stop write traffic, enable feature-flag rollback, apply reverse migration step 1, confirm schema restored, abort backfills. Full steps on the runbook link.
samir: Thanks all. I'll add the calendar invite and mute notifications here until 01:00 UTC unless someone pings. Good luck team. :rocket:
